Class SubListAdapterTest

java.lang.Object
myTest.SubListAdapterTest
public class SubListAdapterTest extends Object
Test suite for the SubListAdapter class.

This test suite verifies the functionality of the SubListAdapter class, which provides a view of a portion of a VectorAdapter or another SubListAdapter. The tests cover various scenarios including construction, element access, modification, and compliance with the HList and HCollection interfaces.

Test Case Design

The test cases are designed to validate the behavior of SubListAdapter against the specifications of Java 1.4.2 Vector class subList functionality. The test design includes categories for basic functionality, edge cases, error conditions, and interaction with the backing vector.

Categories:

  • Constructor and initialization tests
  • Element access and modification tests
  • Size and capacity management tests
  • Collection operation tests
  • Iterator functionality tests
  • Edge case and exception handling tests

    • testSubListValidParameters

      public void testSubListValidParameters()
      Test method to verify that subList creation works correctly with valid parameters.

      Summary:

      This test verifies that a sublist can be created with valid indices and contains the correct elements.

      Test Case Design:

      The test is designed to validate basic sublist functionality with normal parameters, ensuring proper element selection and size calculation.

      Test Description:

      The test creates a VectorAdapter with 5 elements, then creates a sublist from indices 1 to 4. It verifies that the sublist contains the correct elements at the expected positions and has the correct size.

      Pre-Condition:

      - VectorAdapter is initialized with 5 elements: ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5"]

      Post-Condition:

      - SubListAdapter is successfully created with size 3

      - Sublist contains elements ["2", "3", "4"] at indices 0, 1, 2 respectively

      Expected Results:

      Sublist should be created successfully with correct elements and size.

    • testSubListTrimToSizeAffectsOnlyVectorCapacity

      public void testSubListTrimToSizeAffectsOnlyVectorCapacity()
      Test method to verify that trimToSize() on a sublist only affects the capacity of the backing vector.

      Summary:

      This test verifies that calling trimToSize() on a SubListAdapter correctly trims the capacity of the backing vector while maintaining the correct sublist size and element values.

      Test Case Design:

      The test is designed to validate that capacity management operations on sublists properly delegate to the backing vector while preserving the sublist's view boundaries and content.

      Test Description:

      The test creates a VectorAdapter with initial capacity 20 and adds 5 elements. A sublist is created from indices 1 to 4. After calling trimToSize() on the sublist, the test verifies that the capacity has been reduced to match the vector size, while the sublist size remains unchanged and elements are preserved.

      Pre-Condition:

      - VectorAdapter is initialized with capacity 20 and 5 string elements

      - SubListAdapter is created from indices 1 to 4 of the main vector

      Post-Condition:

      - Backing vector capacity is trimmed to match its size

      - Sublist capacity matches vector capacity

      - Sublist size remains unchanged at 3

      Expected Results:

      After trimToSize(), sublist capacity should equal vector size (5), sublist size should remain 3, and all elements should be preserved.

      Test Description:

      - VectorAdapter is initialized with capacity 20 and 5 null elements

      - SubListAdapter is created from indices 1 to 4 of the main vector

      Post-Condition:

      - Sublist capacity matches vector capacity

      - Sublist size remains unchanged at 3 with null elements

      Expected Results:

      After trimToSize(), sublist capacity should equal vector size (5), sublist size should remain 3, and all null elements should be preserved.

    • testSubListEnsureCapacityConstructor

      public void testSubListEnsureCapacityConstructor()
      Test method to verify ensureCapacity() behavior when minimum capacity is smaller than current capacity.

      Summary:

      This test verifies that ensureCapacity() has no effect when the requested minimum capacity is smaller than the current capacity of the sublist.

      Test Case Design:
